name: Adare Manor
insider_take: This neo-Gothic masterpiece sits on 840 acres of pristine Irish countryside, where luxury meets legend in County Limerick's most enchanting estate.
whats_special: Home to Ireland's only Tom Fazio-designed golf course, ranked #1 in Ireland and among the world's top 10. The manor's Great Hall features soaring 75-foot ceilings and hand-carved oak galleries, while the property boasts its own falconry school and the award-winning Oak Room restaurant with Michelin-starred cuisine.
pro_tip: Book the Carriage House suites for ultimate privacy - they feature private gardens and are just steps from the spa's hydrotherapy pool.
dont_miss: The daily falconry demonstrations with Harris hawks and peregrine falcons, afternoon tea in the Drawing Room overlooking the River Maigue, and a sunset horseback ride through the estate's ancient woodlands where monks once walked centuries ago.
pros: Championship golf course designed by Tom Fazio
Historic castle setting with luxurious modern amenities
Exceptional fine dining and Michelin-starred cuisine
cons: Rural location requires travel to major city attractions
